correctness.rationale: PASS: Complementation of P4-free graph family is exact involution, so W_n(S)=(-1)^|S|W_n(S), proving odd-support zeros. Independently built a stand-alone C++ enumeration, enumerating every 2^binom(n,2) labelled graph for n=4..7; tested P4 by all four-set edge/degree signatures; applied integer FWHT to full indicator, and independently constructed expected 6-vertex exceptional orbit set from every S6 permutation of complements of P4 disjoint 2 isolates and C5 disjoint isolate. Results exactly n4 (52, odd32, even0, rank32, gap4), n5 (472, odd512, even0, rank512, gap8), n6 (5504, odd16384, even252, rank16132, gap16, orbit set exact252), n7 (78416, odd1048576, even0, rank1048576, gap16, all even W congruent16 mod32). Source cograph_mod32.cpp independently formulates N_7(T) forced-edge subsets for |T|<=4 and gives N_empty=78416=16 mod32, singleton39208=8 mod16, higher forced counts divisible by 2^(5-|T|), so W7(S)=16-16|S| mod32. Finite enumeration here is exhaustive, not extrapolation to n>=8.
